statement_blocker: The catalog gloss is not a proposition: it names a maximum number of disjoint paths without its comparator. It omits the graph model, terminal sets or vertices, vertex/internal-vertex/edge disjointness, separator definition, finite or infinite cardinality, local or global formulation, binders, assumptions, conclusion, and boundary cases.
